title: QuantEvidence input v1
description: Domain evidence payload for the Quant adapter's validate_claim. kind classifies what produced the evidence; data_provenance classifies the data it rests on (synthetic, sample, real point-in-time, production). The adapter constrains kind/provenance consistency (a synthetic_backtest cannot carry real_pit provenance); the schema itself only fixes the two vocabularies (ADR-0005 decision 1).

kind.description: What produced this evidence item. Backtest kinds are split by data class so the ceiling rule can distinguish synthetic, sample, and real point-in-time runs.

data_provenance.description: Data the evidence rests on: synthetic (engineered data proving pipeline behavior only), sample (real but partial or non-representative extracts), real_pit (point-in-time correct historical data), production (live-trading records).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the underlying artifact (report file, run log, audit export). Binds the evidence payload to a concrete artifact.

limitations.description: Known limitations of this evidence. Required; explicit empty array only after consideration.
